title: The destination country and port of exit errors read 'Select the …' where DR1 and GDS style read 'Select a …'.

finding.frontend: Leaving either select unanswered gives 'Select the destination country' and 'Select the port of exit' (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/destination-country/copy/copy.en.js:9 and src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/port-of-exit/copy/copy.en.js:9). The definite article implies the service already knows which one is meant.
finding.prototype: DR1's messages for the same two failures are 'Select a destination country' and 'Select a port of exit', on both the transit and the transhipment or temporary-admission branches (app/routes.js:1397-1440). This is the GDS wording for a choice the user has yet to make.
finding.difference: Change the two messages to 'Select a destination country' and 'Select a port of exit'. Both sides already require both fields, so nothing but the wording moves. Check the rest of the journey for the same 'Select the …' pattern while the file is open — the phrasing should be consistent across the service rather than fixed on two pages.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding DR1 rendering 'Select the destination country' or 'Select the port of exit' for a missing answer.
finding.correction: Verified sound, strings quoted correctly on both sides. WHERE EACH SIDE ENFORCES: unlike the other validation findings in this slice, this one is symmetrical — both sides require both fields at the point of submit, so only the wording differs. The frontend uses requiredOneOf on destinationCountry (destination-country/controller.js:30-37) and on portOfExit (port-of-exit/controller.js:34-37); DR1 rejects the same two omissions in validateImportReasonProceed (app/routes.js:1396-1440). The frontend also holds both as mandatory obligations under the applicable reasons, and DR1 holds both in hasImportReasonComplete, so the later gates match too. CONFIRMED VERBATIM: frontend 'Select the destination country' and 'Select the port of exit'; DR1 'Select a destination country' and 'Select a port of exit', with the indefinite article used identically across the transit, transhipment and temporary-admission branches. NOTE ON THE 'check the rest of the journey' instruction: the origin page carries a third instance of the pattern, 'Select the country where the animal originates from' (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/origin/copy/copy.en.js), which has no DR1 counterpart because DR1 does not validate the country on the page at all — so it can be brought into line for consistency but is not a parity difference. HOW CHECKED: read both copy files and both validators on the frontend, and validateImportReasonProceed on DR1.
